AccountWorkspace.title: AccountWorkspace
AccountWorkspace.description: Cloud-synced SENTRA UIB workspace account document keyed by deterministic SHA-256 accountKey, storing hashed login verifier and full per-account organization state.

accountKey.description: Deterministic SHA-256 hex key derived from normalized full name.

userId.description: Unique user identifier for the account.

normalizedName.description: Trimmed, collapsed-whitespace lowercase account full name.

displayName.description: Formatted display name of the account owner.

statePayload.description: Native Firestore map containing all per-account SENTRA UIB organization records (without plaintext password).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when account was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest cloud sync.

AccountSecret.title: AccountSecret
AccountSecret.description: Write-only authorization verifier paired atomically with AccountWorkspace so updates require proving knowledge of the account password.

authVerifier.description: SHA-256 write authorization verifier (never readable via client SDK).

previousAuthVerifier.description: Previous authVerifier supplied during updates to authorize mutations.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when secret record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest authorized write.

/accounts/{accountKey}.description: Stores each SENTRA UIB account workspace synced across all user devices.

/accountSecrets/{accountKey}.description: Non-readable write-proof verifier documents enforcing authorized updates to accounts.
